_about: Sea step 8 RANDOM ENCOUNTERS (director 2026-11-18: enemies come as random encounters while sailing, weighted by region, weather and night; pirate ships both by size: small ones fire broadsides from range, big ones also board (8b); loot both: floating debris + drops on deck after a boarding fight). The HOST rolls (core/sea/encounter_rules.gd) every check_seconds for each player at sea outside the safe waters round the home port: chance = base x region[n] x weather x night x (anchored or moving), capped by max_foes alive; a kind is picked by weight among the kinds allowed in that region / at that hour; it comes in spawn_m away within spawn_cone_deg of the player's ship's bow (or of his facing when swimming). Pirates (core/sea/pirate_rules.gd): engage between range_m, fire when the target lies within the cannon arc and fire_range_m, flee below flee_hull, give up beyond lose_m from every player. A pirate ship sunk leaves flotsam (game/sea_flotsam.gd): count pieces, each with doubloons x the region's loot_mult, a few materials, and a chance of a rolled gun at the region's item level. ALL NUMBERS PLACEHOLDERS.

crews._about: Sea step 8b: pirate crews on deck (core/sea/deck_walk.gd, game/sea_crews.gd). Musketeers shoot at players within see_m; cutlass men and the captain fight whoever stands on their deck. A boarder (kind 'boarders' > 0) closes to board_keep_m abeam of a player's ship and, within board_m, swings that many of her crew across one after another (cutlass men and the captain first). Crew are tougher by region (hp/damage_per_region) and count as tier_first + tier_per_region * (region - 1) for kill XP. Beating off the boarders leaves deck_loot chests on the defended deck; clearing a foe's own deck leaves them on hers and she strikes (no guns, no sail). Musketeers fire at players on other ships within musket_range (balls at musket_speed, led for her speed, musket_error_deg off). A crewman pushed hard past the rail (overboard_push m/s) or on a sinking ship goes into the sea, swims (swim_speed) to the nearest ship's ladder and climbs (climb_s); with no ship to reach he drowns after drown_s (no kill pay). Ships with a hold (sea step 8b-2) keep kinds[].below men in it: once a player is within below_wake_m (or her boarding starts) one climbs the companion stair every below_up_s; a player who goes down fights them there.

sharks._about: Sea step 8c sharks (game/sea_sharks.gd). Host keeps per_swimmer sharks for each player / pirate in deep water (inside_by >= deep_m from land), blood_extra more for one bleeding (bitten within blood_s), at most max; with nobody in the water a player on a deck in deep water gets `roaming` fins circling his ship. A hunting shark circles circle_s at circle_m (closing), then lunges (lunge_speed) and bites (bite, bite_every) within bite_m of its head. fin_depth = how deep its belly swims while circling (the dorsal fin cuts the surface). Tougher by region. harvest: a shark killed within window_s of our harpoon gives Hunting xp and these parts.

serpent._about: Sea step 8c the Tide Wyrm (game/sea_serpent.gd), a rare encounter (kinds sea_serpent: region 2+, weather_mult storm). Approaches under water (dive_speed), surfaces ring_m off the side of the ship its quarry is on for surface_s, bites her hull (bite_hull, every bite_every) and lunges at the nearest player within lunge_reach (rears up lunge_windup s, then lunge_damage to everyone within lunge_radius of the spot, every lunge_every), dives (dive_s) and comes up on her other side. Body segments take segment_share of a hit; cannon balls deal cannons.json creature_damage. Leaves when nobody is within lose_m. Hp / damage grow by region. Slain = loot afloat.
